laws.rule: Rincón de la Vieja: Las Pailas sector Tuesday to Sunday 8 am to 3 pm; Santa María Thursday to Monday 8 am to 3:30 pm; tickets online only. Non-resident adults US$16.95 (about A$24.08 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026), children US$5.65 (about A$8.03 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026). Active Crater trail closed for volcanic activity; no swimming at the waterfalls; no smoking, drugs or alcohol; removing plants, rocks or animals is illegal.
laws.heading: Parque Nacional Rincón de la Vieja

laws.rule: Parque Nacional Rincón de la Vieja: Las Pailas: Tuesday-Sunday 08:00-15:00, closed Monday. Santa María: Thursday-Monday 08:00-15:30, closed Tuesday and Wednesday. Entrance tickets online only. The page marks Santa María camping currently closed and the active-crater trail closed for volcanic activity. General camping/cooking advice is not proof those facilities have reopened.
